parts-common.title: Common parts for this repair
parts-common.intro: If you already have a model number and want to look up a part or diagram yourself, these are the parts catalogs we plan to link once an affiliate program is approved. A local technician can also source the part for you.

parts-ge.title: Genuine GE parts and filters
parts-ge.intro: For GE and Profile appliances, a manufacturer parts store is one place to check a filter or OEM part. This placement is reserved until the official program is approved.

tools.title: Tools people use for simple checks
tools.intro: A basic multimeter or hand tool is sometimes enough for a homeowner safety check, but sealed-system and live-voltage work belong with a technician. Links will go live only after a tools program is approved.

replace-appliance.title: If you are replacing the machine
replace-appliance.intro: After a written diagnosis, some people compare the repair quote with a new unit. These retailer placements are reserved until a program is approved. We are not recommending a brand or model here.

warranty-protect.title: Protect it next time
warranty-protect.intro: A home warranty or product-protection plan is a different product from hiring a local technician, and the company may dispatch its own network. Compare terms carefully. These links are placeholders; we do not currently earn a commission from them.
